generation.scope: For every irreducible symmetric three-plane with independent self-brackets, all complementary three-planes of each prescribed cubic are reconstructed by two scalar equations and linear algebra, including singular/reducible cubics and nonreduced harmonic base schemes. The zero center is scheme-theoretically the distinguished plane plus that length-four base. Every smooth prescribed cubic, even through nonreduced base, is itself the complete elliptic quintic of possible planes.

open_mathematics: Identify the exact four-secant obstruction for a fixed smooth cubic and a fixed metric by analyzing degree-three and degree-four divisors of the elliptic normal sextic. Relate admissible four-point sets to finite mixed Frobenius seeds, before testing the remaining ordered bases and inverse lifts.
